feeds.title: Art Spark Texas Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1996, with the vision to foster equity across all cultural sectors of society, we believe that arts experiences enhance the skills, confidence and quality of life for all people, and our goal is to ensure that these experiences are fully accessible, welcoming, engaging and respectful. Art Spark Texas creates arts-inspired, inclusive communities of people with and without disability. Get the latest updates on Art Spark Texas and upcoming events.

feeds.title: Reynaldo Alaniz Art Blog
feeds.description: Reynaldo Alaniz is an accomplished artist in various media including sculpture and paintings. Get the latest news and updates on his artworks, travels and more!

feeds.title: Julie Ahmad Contemporary Art Blog
feeds.description: Follow visual artist Julie Ahmad's blogs for the latest abstract art news and updates here! Julie is a Feminist Abstract artist who paints from intuition and a rooted sense of responsibility for social awareness by utilizing symbolism, color and expressive techniques.

feeds.title: EASTside Magazine » Art
feeds.description: EASTside Magazine is a lifestyle and entertainment magazine that delivers passionate and creative coverage of the East Austin community. Get the latest updates on art events and workshops from different artists in the city.

feeds.title: CultureMap Austin » Arts
feeds.description: The essential source for daily arts news, theater reviews, profiles of actors and artists, and the best art museums, galleries and theaters in Austin. CultureMap is your source for local lifestyle news. We report on the things that matter to you most, like where to eat and what to do in the cities we serve, as well as fun tidbits about what's happening around the state.

feeds.title: Imagine Art Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with all that is happening at Imagine Art. For more events, news, and updates subscribe to our newsletter below. Our Mission is to leverage art and place; empowering artists with disabilities who become creative catalysts for changing systems of day habilitation; long-term care, peer support, and affordable housing. Imagine Art is a Christian ministry, a 501c3 nonprofit, established in 1996. The Imagine Art community positions artists with disabilities to be creative placemakers and leaders.

feeds.title: Blanton Museum of Art Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is a source of primary, historical art information, exhibition news and more! As the primary art collection for the city of Austin, the Blanton Museum of Art is a major resource for the community. With more than 21,000 works in the collection, the Blanton showcases art from across the ages, from ancient Greek pottery to abstract expressionism.

feeds.title: Dave McClinton Art Blog
feeds.description: In the African American community, we are slowly rediscovering our history that has not been fully illustrated. It's my job as visual communicator to review historical information and inform the community by bringing these concepts to life and help visually define our identity. And to distribute these stories about the strengths and trials of the African American community. Explore more on events, arts and more!

feeds.title: Print Austin Blog
feeds.description: PrintAustin is an artist-led nonprofit organization working to showcase traditional and contemporary approaches in printmaking. Our mission is to share our enthusiasm for printmaking by helping galleries, universities, and artists curate, exhibit, and promote works on paper and to engage a wider audience through artist talks, signings, panels, printmaking demonstrations, and print-focused art happenings. Explore our blog to read about artists' experiences, arts and more!

feeds.title: Austin Creative Art Center Blog
feeds.description: Stay in the loop so you can be part of our art. We'll let you know about upcoming events, exhibits, classes and camps. Austin Creative Art Center focuses on studio art, combining the disciplines of painting, drawing, sculpture, ceramics, mixed media and design concepts to emphasize creativity and skill development. Students gain technical knowledge and expertise in visual arts. The goal is to produce expressive artists of originality that will be willing to explore various ideas, values and beliefs that will contribute to contemporary art and culture.

feeds.title: Raw Paw Blog
feeds.description: Find out what is happening in the world of Raw Paw with our blog. Raw Paw is a family of friends based in Austin, Texas screen printing fun, art-driven, ethically made clothing and goods for artists, businesses, and ourselves. We take an active role in our community by hosting events and workshops, buying wholesale goods, and acting as a creative agency.

feeds.title: Sightlines » Art
feeds.description: An online magazine of arts, film, culture, & ideas. Reviews, interviews and news. Browse through our arts section for the latest news and updates from the arts sector, exhibitions, events and more!

feeds.title: Austin Texas » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: This blog, written and curated by Visit Austin staff, shares the things about arts and culture that visitors love and locals can't get enough of. Visit Austin has the best job in town. We're here to promote all of the things in Austin that people are already talking about. This city has a one-of-a-kind culture and universal appeal, and we want to make sure people know about it.

feeds.title: Magic of Modern Art Blog
feeds.description: Robyn Jamison is an artist on a mission-a mission to make the magic and wonder of modern and contemporary art accessible to everyone in the world. Robyn is a visual artist, published author, avid tap dancer and accomplished pianist. Stay up to date with Robyn's arts and events, book events and more!
